### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines? 



### 1.0 Package requirements

- Include required packages 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("stringr")
require("DESeq2")
require("MASS")
require("apeglm")
require("PCAtools")
require("rtracklayer")
require("EnhancedVolcano")

```

### 2.0 Include experiment matrix

- Let's first include the reactivity gene expression matrix and the supplied experiment matrix.

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

experiment_matrix_df <- data.table::fread("01-alignment/input_files/nfcore_sampleinfo.csv", data.table = F)
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,2]
experiment_matrix_df$replicate <- str_split(experiment_matrix_df$sample, pattern = "_", simplify = T)[,1]
experiment_matrix_df <- experiment_matrix_df[,-c(2,3,4)]
experiment_matrix_df$condition <- ifelse(experiment_matrix_df$replicate %in% c("C2", "C6"), "Control", "ALS")

experiment_matrix_df$condition <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$condition, levels = c("Control", "ALS"))
experiment_matrix_df$ERAP <- factor(experiment_matrix_df$ERAP, levels = c("CTRL", "ERAP2"))
experiment_matrix_df$col_names <- paste(experiment_matrix_df$sample, seq_len(nrow(experiment_matrix_df)), sep = "_")

```

### 3.0 Perform differential expression profiling

- Import counts matrix

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

gene_expression_matrix <- read.table("01-alignment/nfcore/star_rsem/rsem.merged.gene_counts.tsv", header = T)
rownames(gene_expression_matrix) <- gene_expression_matrix[,1]
gene_expression_matrix <- gene_expression_matrix[,match(experiment_matrix_df$sample, colnames(gene_expression_matrix))]
colnames(gene_expression_matrix) <- experiment_matrix_df$col_names

```

- Perform differential expression profiling in whole cells 

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
	countData = round(gene_expression_matrix),
    colData = experiment_matrix_df,
    design = ~ ERAP + condition + ERAP:condition)
de_object <- DESeq(dds)
dds_vst <- assay(vst(dds))

de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = c("ERAP", "ERAP2", "CTRL"))

de_object_als_vs_ctrl <- results(de_object, contrast = c("condition", "ALS", "Control"))

de_object_erap2_kd_als <- results(de_object, name = "ERAPERAP2.conditionALS")

de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl <- results(de_object, 
    contrast = list(c("condition_ALS_vs_Control", "ERAPERAP2.conditionALS")))

all_de_object_list <- list(
    "erap2_kd_effect_in_control" = de_object_erap2_kd_ctrl,
    "als_vs_ctrl_in_ctrl_cells" = de_object_als_vs_ctrl,
    "erap2_kd_effect_in_als" = de_object_erap2_kd_als,
    "effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl" = de_object_erap2_kd_als_vs_ctrl)

saveRDS(object = list(vst_matrix = dds_vst, 
    differential_object = de_object,
    contrasts = all_de_object_list),
    file = file.path("02-differential-expression-profiling/rdata_files/2023-03-22-01-newsamples-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))


```

### 4.0 Perform PCA analysis

- Perform Plot of deseq2 object 


```{r fig.cap = "PCA plot of DESeq2 samples differentially expressed genes", include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}


# rownames(dds_vst) <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(dds_vst), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
pca_object <- pca(dds_vst, metadata = colData(dds), removeVar = 0.1)

new_names <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(rownames(pca_object$loadings), annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
duplicated_names <- new_names[new_names %in% new_names[duplicated(new_names)]]
new_names[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names] <- rownames(pca_object$loadings)[is.na(new_names) | new_names %in% duplicated_names ]

rownames(pca_object$loadings) <- new_names


pdf("02-differential-expression-profiling/plots/01-pca_plot.pdf")
  biplot(pca_object, showLoadings = TRUE,
    labSize = 3, 
    pointSize = 3, 
    sizeLoadingsNames = 3,
    colby = "condition",
    legendPosition = "bottom",
    hline = 0,
    vline = 0)
dev.off()

```

### 5.0 Make volcano plot

- Plot volcano plot

```{r}


all_de_objects_list <- readRDS(file.path("02-differential-expression-profiling/rdata_files/2023-03-22-01-newsamples-differentially-expressed-objects.rds"))
de_analysis_list <- all_de_objects_list$contrasts
de_object <- all_de_objects_list$differential_object

all_de_df_list <- lapply(names(de_analysis_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    a_de_object <- de_analysis_list[[x]]
    filter <- !is.na(a_de_object$padj)
    logfcs <- a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # if(!is.na(contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x])){
    #     ref_name <- contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x]
    #     ref_lfcs <- de_analysis_list[[ref_name]]$log2FoldChange[filter]
    #     logfcs <- ref_lfcs[filter] - a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # }

    data.frame(contrasts = x, 
        gene_ids = rownames(a_de_object)[filter],
        logfc = logfcs,
        pval = a_de_object$pvalue[filter],
        padj = a_de_object$padj[filter])
})
all_de_df <- do.call(rbind, all_de_df_list)


de_df_list <- lapply(names(de_analysis_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    a_de_object <- de_analysis_list[[x]]
    filter <- a_de_object$padj < 0.05 & !is.na(a_de_object$padj)
    logfcs <- a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # if(!is.na(contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x])){
    #     ref_name <- contrast_ref_df$reference_names[contrast_ref_df$contrast_names == x]
    #     ref_lfcs <- de_analysis_list[[ref_name]]$log2FoldChange[filter]
    #     logfcs <- ref_lfcs - a_de_object$log2FoldChange[filter]
    # }
    if(any(filter)){
        return(data.frame(contrasts = x, 
                gene_ids = rownames(a_de_object)[filter],
                logfc = logfcs,
                pval = a_de_object$pvalue[filter],
                padj = a_de_object$padj[filter]))
    }
    return(NULL)
})
de_df <- do.call(rbind, de_df_list)

de_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(de_df$gene_ids, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
all_de_df$gene_name <- annotation_gene_ranges$gene_name[match(all_de_df$gene_ids, annotation_gene_ranges$gene_id)]
all_de_df <- all_de_df[!is.na(all_de_df$gene_name),]

intersecting_genes_als_vs_ctrl <- intersect(de_df$gene_name[de_df$contrast == "als_vs_ctrl_in_ctrl_cells"], de_df$gene_name[de_df$contrast == "effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl"])
intersecting_genes_als_vs_ctrl <- intersecting_genes_als_vs_ctrl[!is.na(intersecting_genes_als_vs_ctrl)]

saveRDS(object = de_df, file = file.path("02-differential-expression-profiling/rdata_files/01-significantly-differentially-expressed-genes-pval-less-than-0.05.RDS"))

source("src/plot_functions.R")

require("ggplot2")
require("RColorBrewer")


lapply(unique(all_de_df$contrasts), function(x){
    make_volcano_plot(plot_df = all_de_df[all_de_df$contrasts == x & !is.na(all_de_df$logfc),], 
        logfc_threshold = 5, highlight_genes = intersecting_genes_als_vs_ctrl,

})
```

### 5.0 Effect of ERAP2 KD on Control and ALS cells
The central questions posed within this analysis is whether ERAP2 KD in ALS samples has a normalisation effect on any or some genes. To investigate this, we focus our attention towards the ERAP2 KD effect. In short, we will attempt to maximise the correlation coefficient between the effect of ERAP2 KD and ALS vs Control. 

```{r include = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- de_df[de_df$contrasts == "als_vs_ctrl_in_ctrl_cells",]
sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df[!is.na(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$padj) & 
    !is.na(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$gene_name),]

erap2_kd_effect_df <- all_de_df[all_de_df$contrasts == "erap2_kd_effect_in_als",]
erap2_kd_effect_df <- erap2_kd_effect_df[!is.na(erap2_kd_effect_df) &
    !is.na(erap2_kd_effect_df$gene_name),]

erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df <- all_de_df[all_de_df$contrasts == "effect_of_erap2_kd_in_als_vs_ctrl",]
erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df <- erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df[!is.na(erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df) &
    !is.na(erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df$gene_name),]


sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_lfc <- erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df$logfc[match(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$gene_id, erap2_als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_df$gene_ids)]
sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df[!is.na(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_lfc),]
sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df[order(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_lfc, decreasing = T),]


sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$kd_effect_lfc <- erap2_kd_effect_df$logfc[match(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$gene_id, erap2_kd_effect_df$gene_ids)]
sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df[!is.na(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$kd_effect_lfc),]
sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df <- sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df[order(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$kd_effect_lfc, decreasing = T),]

```

- Modelling the relationship between ALS vs Control and ERAP2 KD effect

```{r}

    the_plot <- ggplot(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df, aes(x = logfc, y = kd_effect_lfc))
```

```{r}
    top_npercent <- quantile(abs(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df$als_vs_ctrl_kd_effect_lfc), 0.05)
```

- Select genes affected by ERAP2 KD effect

```{r}

lm_eqn <- function(df){
    m <- lm(kd_effect_lfc ~ logfc, df);
    eq <- substitute(italic(kd_effect) == a + b %.% italic(logfc)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2, 
         list(a = format(unname(coef(m)[1]), digits = 2),
              b = format(unname(coef(m)[2]), digits = 2),
             r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))
    as.character(as.expression(eq));
}

labels <- data.frame(text = lm_eqn(selected_genes_df))

the_plot <- ggplot(sig_als_vs_ctrl_de_df, aes(x = logfc, y = kd_effect_lfc))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_point(fill = "#F1F7ED", shape = 21, colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_point(data = selected_genes_df, fill = "#FF3C38", shape = 21, colour = "#000000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_smooth(method = "lm", lty = "dashed", colour = "#000000", se = FALSE)
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_text(data = labels, x = -2.5, y = 2, aes(label = text), parse = TRUE)
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = "dashed", colour = "#FF0000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed", colour = "#FF0000")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_x_continuous("log2 fold change (als vs control)")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_y_continuous("ERAP2 KD effect")
the_plot <- the_plot + theme_bw()
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_fill_distiller("erap2 kd effect of fc", direction = 1, palette = "Reds")

        legend.position = "bottom",
```
